title: [BUG] Sync failure: cannot fetch treatments or pump status under NSV3 (must switch to NSV1 temporarily
symptom: When starting AAPS client in NSV3 mode, pump status is not displayed and no treatment data is received. Switching to NSV1 makes treatments and pump status load correctly, but switching back to NSV3 causes the issue again.
evidence_quote:
Start AAPS client in NSV3
2. Pump status not displayed, no treatment data received
3. Switch to NSV1
4. Treatments and pump status load correctly
